description: This file defines the ImportModuleTask class, which handles importing and setting up a module within an Android project, including loading the module, adding Android facets, and configuring the Android SDK.

classes.name: ImportModuleTask
classes.description: A class responsible for importing a module into an Android project, including loading the module, adding Android facets, and configuring SDK.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Executes the module import process, loading the module, adding Android facet if missing, and setting up the Android SDK.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns a descriptive title for the import task, including module name and file path.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Extracts and returns the module name from the module file path.

methods.name: getContentRoot
methods.description: Returns the content root VirtualFile associated with the module.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on project, module file path, and content root.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on project, module file path, and content root.
